check: 17 spare-shell: can the core host a terminal that hc and mods don't see?
method: isolated core (scripts/perf/instance.py, session probe17, hc from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\herdr-core); hc run --bg --json --keep --no-parent --cwd <folder> with no argv and no labels, then hc ls --json and hc ls

app_side: mods' terminals() is the core's event snapshot (src/hc.rs:52, src/mods.rs:1123): every core terminal, documented as such in defaults/AGENTS.md:1072-1073
